# WEXP × EMILIA INTEROP-001 — Experimental Interoperability Record

Artifact ID: `WEXP-EMILIA-INTEROP-001`

Terminal result: **Branch A — Explicit Bridge Required**

This controlled experiment used independently frozen readings and expectations
over shared byte-identical fixtures. EMILIA reproduced its frozen P/P-1
expectations. WEXP remained underdetermined because no frozen public mapping
constructed the required WEXP input. No genuine semantic disagreement was
established.

This record does not claim full interoperability, WEXP conformance, EMILIA
conformance beyond its reproduced result, mutual validation, semantic
equivalence, physical truth, positive WEXP appraisal, WEXP implementation
execution, IETF approval or status, standardization status, or a normative
EP→WEXP mapping.
